selected_evidence.requirement: Publish only the approved boot tree as a read-only TFTP root
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the enabled service, effective secure root, UDP/69 listener, persistent ReadOnlyPaths restriction, and absence of unauthorized uploaded files.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 downloads boot.cfg and firmware.bin without changing firmware bytes
selected_evidence.summary: The staged and downloaded files have identical SHA-256 hashes; firmware.bin remains 40 bytes and boot.cfg 45 bytes.

selected_evidence.requirement: Reject uploads and requests outside the boot root
selected_evidence.summary: Traversal and absolute-path reads returned File not found; new uploads were rejected and boot.cfg overwrite returned Permission denied. Server-side evidence confirms no unauthorized file appeared and hashes remained unchanged.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel and use compatible software
selected_evidence.summary: Both nodes remained Ubuntu 24.04 with kernel 6.8.0-71-generic; native Ubuntu tftpd-hpa/tftp-hpa 5.2 packages are installed.

set -u
server_ip=$(printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_HOSTS" | awk '$2=="node1" {print $1; exit}')
[ -n "$server_ip" ] || { printf '%s\n' 'node1 IP not found'; exit 1; }
work=/tmp/tftp-verification-node2
sudo rm -rf "$work"
mkdir -m 0700 "$work"
printf 'SERVER=%s CLIENT=%s\n' "$server_ip" "$NODE_IP"
printf '%s\n' '--- approved downloads ---'
tftp "$server_ip" -m binary -c get boot.cfg "$work/boot.cfg"
rc_cfg=$?
tftp "$server_ip" -m binary -c get firmware.bin "$work/firmware.bin"
rc_fw=$?
printf 'download_rc boot.cfg=%s firmware.bin=%s\n' "$rc_cfg" "$rc_fw"
sha256sum "$work/boot.cfg" "$work/firmware.bin"
printf '%s\n' '--- outside-root requests (expected rejection) ---'
outside1=$(tftp "$server_ip" -m binary -c get ../private/vendor-notes.txt "$work/outside-relative" 2>&1); rc_out1=$?
printf 'relative_rc=%s output=%s\n' "$rc_out1" "$outside1"
outside2=$(tftp "$server_ip" -m binary -c get /etc/passwd "$work/outside-absolute" 2>&1); rc_out2=$?
printf 'absolute_rc=%s output=%s\n' "$rc_out2" "$outside2"
printf 'outside_files_created='; find "$work" -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -name 'outside-*' \) -printf '%f ' ; printf '\n'
printf '%s\n' '--- upload attempts (expected rejection) ---'
printf 'unauthorized-upload\n' > "$work/upload-source"
put_new=$(tftp "$server_ip" -m binary -c put "$work/upload-source" upload-attempt.bin 2>&1); rc_put_new=$?
printf 'new_upload_rc=%s output=%s\n' "$rc_put_new" "$put_new"
put_existing=$(tftp "$server_ip" -m binary -c put "$work/upload-source" boot.cfg 2>&1); rc_put_existing=$?
printf 'overwrite_rc=%s output=%s\n' "$rc_put_existing" "$put_existing"
printf '%s\n' '--- client-side postconditions ---'
[ "$rc_cfg" -eq 0 ] && [ "$rc_fw" -eq 0 ]
[ ! -e "$work/outside-relative" ] && [ ! -e "$work/outside-absolute" ]
printf 'approved downloads present; outside files absent\n'
